info.title: Agrani API
info.description:
The Agrani REST API is versioned under `/api/v1`.

Successful resources use a `data` envelope and may include `meta`. Errors use an `error` object containing a stable `code`, a safe `message`, and optional validation `fields`; every error also includes a `request_id`.

```json
{"data":{"status":"ok"}}
```

```json
{"error":{"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"The given data was invalid.","fields":{"email":["The email field is required."]}},"request_id":"..."}
```
